name: 首科行程助手·滴滴接入
description: 行程助手自定义连接器，调用滴滴官方远程 MCP，支持打车查价、手机跳转入口及经确认的订单操作。
description_en: A custom travel assistant connector for DiDi's official remote MCP, with fare estimates, ride links and confirmed order actions.
examples_zh: 查一下从北京西站到国贸打车多少钱，只查价
生成从已确认起点去会场的滴滴手机打开链接
examples_en: Estimate a ride from Beijing West Railway Station to Guomao without booking.
Generate a DiDi ride link for my confirmed pickup and venue.
